question: How should the complete mātṛkā be recited in relation to the root mantra?
premises: The recitation occurs at the end of the root mantra.
The entire mātṛkā is to be uttered.
inference: One should utter the entire mātṛkā at the end of the root mantra together with the threefold tāra.
plain_english: At the end of the root mantra, after the three tāras, one should utter the entire mātṛkā.
